methods_used: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, PUBYEAR>2023, sort=-coverDate, paged start/count 0..675, 700 records scanned)
PubMed E-utilities ESearch/EFetch (Carbohydr Polym[ta] AND Journal Article[pt] NOT Review[pt], datetype=pdat reldate=730, datetype=edat reldate=2/7)
PubMed EFetch pubtype/abstract verification for review and microbe-centric exclusion
WebSearch supplemental search for keywords: paper, cellulose, pectin, hydrogel, okara, paper coating, biomass, soybean protein isolate
WebSearch abstract-summary retrieval for the 2 final articles (Elsevier Abstract Retrieval API FULL view returned 401 AUTHORIZATION_ERROR; only METADATA view accessible)
notes: Elsevier Abstract/Article Retrieval API access limited to METADATA view (AUTHORIZATION_ERROR on FULL view), so full abstract text for the 2 confirmed new articles was reconstructed from WebSearch-indexed public summaries rather than the Elsevier API. Exclusion breakdown from the 20 not-yet-seen Scopus candidates: 11 Review/Editorial, 7 microbe-centric research articles, leaving 2 qualifying new research articles.

exclusion_summary.notes: Scanned Scopus ISSN(0144-8617) AND PUBYEAR>2023, sorted -coverDate, start=0..675 (700 records). After removing already-seen DOIs, corrigenda/erratum/retraction, 20 unseen candidates remained. Of those, 11 were Review/Editorial pubtype and 7 were microbe-centric research (bacterial LPS serology, fungal cell wall biology, lactobacilli EPS secretion, E. coli glycoconjugate vaccine engineering, Bacillus smithii EPS biosynthesis), leaving 2 qualifying new research articles. PubMed ESearch (pdat reldate=730, edat reldate=2/7) cross-check found no additional new items.
